technology.summary: Today's technology news includes the launch of Honor's Magic 9 Pro Max flagship phone in China, featuring a revamped design, powerful camera, and large battery. Nvidia has introduced a new AI safety platform to address rogue hacking incidents, while Instinct, a viral AI agent, has raised $1 billion in Series C funding, valuing the company at $10 billion. Quartermaster, a maritime intelligence startup, has secured $140 million in funding for its real-time ocean surveillance technology. Microsoft has remained silent after church groups requested 1% of data center costs. Philips has released a motion-tracking smart toothbrush in Europe and the US, with a global rollout planned for 2027. Peak XV has increased its Surge seed investment ceiling to $5 million and unveiled an 18-startup cohort.

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a significant downturn in the Indian equity markets, with benchmark indices slipping past vital support thresholds. The Nifty 50 saw a decline of 360.25 points, reflecting increased investor anxiety. Yields on the 10-year benchmark government bond have increased to their highest level since April 2024, following a surge in oil prices and higher global yields. Gold and silver prices fell sharply, leading potential buyers to postpone purchases for upcoming festivals.

politics.summary:
The Supreme Court has given rival factions four weeks to file pleadings and the ECI three months to decide a dispute over the TMC symbol. The court has also cancelled Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre's bail in the Thane doctors' assault case.

In other news, the Centre has been given permission to manufacture patented life-saving medicines. Chirag Paswan has said he is ashamed to be part of the government over rising molestation cases in Bihar.

The Supreme Court has also extended an exemption to Class 6 students in the CBSE Three-Language Policy.
